cases.conclusion: V0.5 minimum-incidence selector chooses d<=2 and existing low-incidence reroot gives N'<=39<=42

derivation: Hard-region premises m>=5 and L>=27 imply m<=6.
Therefore exactly two integer cells remain: (m,L)=(5,28) and (6,27).

minimum_degree_boundary.statement: In either r=9 cell the executed v0.5 selector chooses a root of incidence degree at most 3.
proof: If d_min<=2, the already-proved low-incidence reroot gives N'<=N-4=39, inside the N<=42 induction base.

degree3_case.statement: If the selected minimum degree is 3, the selected pivot is raw-cap safe and produces state_units at most 38.
proof: For (m,L)=(6,27), if d_min=3 then all nine positive incidence degrees sum to 27 and therefore all equal 3.

For (m,L)=(5,28), if d_min=3 then every degree is at least 3 and their sum is 28; hence the degree multiset is eight 3s and one 4, so the minimum-incidence selector necessarily chooses a degree-3 pivot.
A degree-3 pivot is either pure, hence deletion-only, or mixed with polarity bucket split {1,2}.
For mixed split p=1,q=2 (or symmetrically p=2,q=1), the proved generic whole-state raw bound is B_x=s-4+U_singleton.
The singleton pivot clause contains at most the other r-1=8 live variables, so U_singleton<=8.
Both root cells have s=1+m+L=34, therefore B_x<=34-4+8=38 << 1849.

finite_frontier_theorem.name: V0_5_PROOF_SELECTOR_NO_RAW_CAP_RESCUE_REQUIRED_THROUGH_N43
finite_frontier_theorem.statement: Inherit the selector-aligned N<=42 theorem. At N=43 all roots are covered by the existing small-clause, low-incidence reroot, hard-region recurrence, or the two r=9 degree-3 boundary cells above. In the only new cells the actual v0.5 selector either chooses d<=2 and reroots into N<=42, or chooses degree 3, for which the existing generic raw bound gives s'<=38 and the existing tail recurrence remains below 43^2. Thus no legitimate canonical root with N<=43 requires v2/v3 because of ordinary raw-cap unavailability under the v0.5 selector semantics.

next_exact_target: Advance the same explicit v0.5 selector semantics to N=44. Do not alter theorem runtime while testing. Freeze any first uncertified cell as OPEN rather than repairing it post hoc.
